svg.title: Kamayo — edtech · accessibility
svg.desc: Learn Filipino Sign Language, one level at a time. A 100-level path across five stages, a sign dictionary, server-checked progress and row-level security on every record. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, Vitest. Live at kamayo-lyart.vercel.app.
